meta.title: Digital tasbih
meta.description: A modern tasbih: a ring of beads that turns with every tap, targets of 33, 99, or 100, haptic feedback, a soft click, dhikr presets, and a daily record kept on your device.

title: Digital tasbih
description: Tap, count, and keep a daily record
tapHint: Tap the circle, or press Space or Enter

presets.label: Dhikr
presets.tahlil: There is no god but Allah

settings.autoAdvanceHint: After the target: Subhanallah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar, and so on.
settings.soundHint: A soft bead click, generated on the device.

reset.title: Reset the counter?
reset.description: The current count and rounds will return to zero. Your daily record stays.

stats.empty: No dhikr recorded yet. Your counts are saved on this device.
